authorityDecision.text: The statutory forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. arts. 987 through 995 and 998 are treated uniformly as COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY. Generate them faithfully from the current codified article text. Existing PDF renderings of neighbouring articles are references, not a different product class. Do not wait for separate agency-issued fillable PDFs.
